prompt: Pose first: pure side view facing right, Ella hangs from her open umbrella: arms straight up, gloved hands stacked on the shaft just under the canopy, body hanging below like a weight on a string, legs limp, boots pointing straight down. Canopy directly above her head, finial up; the shaft runs down alongside her body to the diamond at her waist. Hair and scarf stream back left. One 21:9 strip of 4 poses, level camera, wide green gaps, whole umbrella inside, 65% of canvas height, same scale, hands and hips at the same height. Pose 1: boots together. Pose 2: boots drift into a narrow V, skirt and hair sway the other way. Pose 3: the V at its widest, still small. Pose 4: boots together. A slow gentle sway. The attached image shows only her open umbrella; copy its design. Dark etched storybook engraving for a 2D sprite: brown-black ink, sepia wash, fine cross-hatching. Mid-tone umber and taupe cloth (#3A2C25, #5C473E, #7A6558), pale taupe (#B9A892) on scarf and gloves; near-black only as hairline ink and the hat crown. Thin rim light and 3 px outline in warm apricot-cream (#FFE6C4, touches of gold #E9C46A). Flat pure green #00FF00 background, edge to edge, empty. Figure colours: umber, taupe, cream, gold. Wordless. Ella: a slender adult woman, always airborne. Tall pointed witch hat with a wide brim, its tip bent over and curling back. Long wavy dark brown hair streams loose past her waist. A dark cloth mask covers her whole face; two small gold eye glints are its only light. A separate long ragged scarf with two tails. Fitted buttoned dark jacket with belt, long sleeves, layered skirt with sawtooth hems to the knee, knit stockings, laced boots, gloves, every inch covered. The umbrella is the only object she holds: an open shallow dome two-thirds as wide as she is tall, eight gores alternating deep umber and mid taupe, scalloped hem; a long thin dark shaft ending in a narrow pierced diamond; at the peak a short dark stem on a small collar ends in one round bead with a tiny point. Both gloved hands grip the shaft.
